title: 第5章 天才与晚餐第6章 完美高中生活系统
slug: 穿越成了游戏里的炮灰角色
content_zh:
回到伊莎贝拉的马车这边，珊迪听到伊莎贝拉嘴里说出的猜测后，不禁瞪大了眼睛，满脸都是难以置信的神色。
半晌之后，她才缓缓说道：“来自更高维？魔界？这怎么可能……”
伊莎贝拉看了珊迪一眼，嘴角微微上扬，露出一抹淡淡的笑容，轻声说道：“如果是魔界的话，刚刚下车的地点就不会是宿舍，而是直接去校长办公室了。”
说完，她又抓起玻璃杯，轻轻地晃荡着里面鲜红的液体，眼神却始终落在珊迪身上。
珊迪被她看得有些不自在，忍不住皱起眉头问道：“那你为什么会认为他看到的是来自更高维的...东西呢？”
“其实蛮好推断的不是吗？他出现了污染的症状，却在短时间内完全消失了。”
伊莎贝拉微微一笑，眼中闪过一丝狡黠的光芒：“别这么紧张，高材生。
你知道最有意思的是什么吗？刚才我施展的情绪魔法，从他身体里排出来的只有一路上的委屈情绪，一点污染都没有。”
“这怎么可能？”
珊迪越听越觉得匪夷所思，灵界的知识伴随污染是召唤师世界中公认的一条定理，所有第一次产生灵视的学生，包括珊迪自己，排出体内的污染都花了近一周。
所谓的灵视，其实就是当一个人拥有成为召唤师的潜质时，或者已经是一名召唤师，成功接触到了灵界之后，所引发的一种独特的精神活动。
这种神秘而奇妙的体验，可能会为召唤师带来各种各样意想不到的收获。
其中包括了灵界的知识，以及对于召唤术的构成和运作方式等等。
然而，伴随着这些神奇的体验而来的，还有来自于灵界的污染。
通常情况下，灵视通常发生在召唤师从低灵密度区域向高灵密度区域移动的时候。
这就像是一个跨越界限的旅程，将他们的灵魂带入了一个全新的领域。
不过，值得注意的是，并不是每一个召唤师都能有幸经历这样的灵视。
要想获得这样的机遇，要么依靠运气的眷顾，要么就得通过某些特定的方法来激发。
所以说，灵视不仅是一种能力的体现，更是一种机遇的象征。
不管惊讶的珊迪，伊莎贝拉继续说道：“完全没发现污染的话只有两种情况，第一他没有产生灵视，第二他产生灵视了，但看到的污染超出了我能观测的程度。

你知道的，我是个心理学家。”
伊莎贝拉着重强调了一下她心理学家的身份。
“从更高维度获取馈赠的案例又不是没有发生过。
放松点吧高材生。”
伊莎贝拉眨了眨眼，随后继续说：“毕竟，这里可是阿瓦隆学院，大陆第一所召唤师学院。”
“完全没有污染的话，那有可能被夺舍了吗？灵视的时候看到一些特殊的灵界生物，被夺舍也不是没有可能。”
珊迪依旧穷追不舍。
伊莎贝拉却没有直接回答珊迪的问题，而是偏过头问：“他从灵视结束，到回答自身相关的问题用了多少秒？”
“45秒。”
珊迪想也没想，立即答道。
“是的，不到一分钟，并且记忆也没有缺失，也没有出现混乱的情况。”
伊莎贝拉浅尝了一口杯中的红色液体，“他还是法伦·特里斯不是吗？”
珊迪听了伊莎贝拉的话，心中稍微安定了一些，“那这件事需要请示副校长吗？”
伊莎贝拉的手指轻轻敲打在玻璃杯上：“估计她老人家很快就会知道的吧，毕竟这个凭空冒出来的天才肯定会吸引所有人的目光。
毕竟小渔港出来的超级天才总会比将军之子更有吸引力不是吗？”
珊迪听了这话，脸色有些不自然，有些不服气地说：“他连召唤术都没学会，就能断定他是天才了吗？”
content_en:
Returning to Isabella's carriage, Sandy couldn't help but widen her eyes after hearing the speculation coming out of Isabella's mouth, with a look of disbelief on her face.
After a while, she slowly said: "From a higher dimension? The devil world? How is this possible..."
Isabella glanced at Sandy, raised the corners of her mouth slightly, revealed a faint smile, and said softly: "If it were the devil world, the place where we got off the bus just now would not be the dormitory, but go directly to the principal's office."
After saying that, she grabbed the glass again and gently swayed the bright red liquid inside, but her eyes always fell on Sandy.
Sandy felt a little uncomfortable when she saw him, and couldn't help but frown and asked: "Then why do you think what he saw was... something from a higher dimension?"
"It's actually quite easy to deduce, isn't it? He showed symptoms of contamination, but completely disappeared within a short period of time."
Isabella smiled slightly, with a cunning light flashing in her eyes: "Don't be so nervous, top student.
Do you know what’s most interesting? The emotional magic I just cast expelled from his body only the grievances along the way, without any pollution at all. "
"How is this possible?"
The more Sandy listened, the more unbelievable it became. It is a recognized theorem in the world of summoners that the knowledge of the spiritual world is accompanied by pollution. It took nearly a week for all students who had spiritual vision for the first time, including Sandy herself, to expel the pollution from their bodies.
The so-called spiritual vision is actually a unique spiritual activity that occurs when a person has the potential to become a summoner, or is already a summoner and successfully contacts the spirit world.
This mysterious and wonderful experience may bring all kinds of unexpected gains to the summoner.
This includes knowledge of the spiritual world, as well as the composition and operation of summoning spells, etc.
However, along with these magical experiences comes pollution from the spiritual world.
Normally, vision usually occurs when the summoner moves from an area of ​​low spiritual density to an area of ​​high spiritual density.
It's like a journey across boundaries that takes their souls into a whole new realm.
However, it is worth noting that not every summoner is lucky enough to experience such a vision.
To obtain such an opportunity, one must either rely on luck or stimulate it through certain specific methods.
Therefore, spiritual vision is not only a manifestation of ability, but also a symbol of opportunity.
Regardless of the surprised Sandy, Isabella continued: "If no pollution is found at all, there are only two situations. First, he did not have spiritual vision, and second, he did have spiritual vision, but the pollution he saw exceeded the level that I could observe.
You know, I'm a psychologist. "
Isabella emphasized her identity as a psychologist.
“It’s not unheard of to receive gifts from higher dimensions.
Relax, top student. "
Isabella blinked, and then continued: "After all, this is Avalon Academy, the first Summoner Academy on the mainland."
"If there is no pollution at all, is it possible that the body was taken away? When I saw some special spiritual creatures during the spiritual vision, it is not impossible that the body was taken away."
Sandy is still in pursuit.
Isabella did not answer Sandy's question directly, but turned her head and asked: "How many seconds did it take him from the end of the vision to answering his own questions?"
"45 seconds."
Sandy answered immediately without thinking.
"Yes, less than a minute, and there is no memory loss or confusion."
Isabella took a sip of the red liquid in the cup, "He's still Fallon Tris, isn't he?"
Sandy felt a little more at ease after hearing Isabella's words, "Do I need to ask the vice principal for permission on this matter?"
Isabella tapped her fingers lightly on the glass: "I guessShe will find out soon, after all, this genius who appears out of nowhere will definitely attract everyone's attention.
After all, a super genius from a small fishing port is always more attractive than a general's son, right? "
After hearing this, Sandy looked a little unnatural and said unconvincingly: "He hasn't even learned the summoning technique, can we conclude that he is a genius? "
